evals.name: kids-birthday-rsvp
evals.prompt: invite for my daughter Myra's 7th birthday, unicorn theme, sun 13 dec 5-8pm, party hall at Prestige Shantiniketan clubhouse, Whitefield. rsvp to me (Divya) by wed 9 dec. warm and fun
evals.expected_output: A warm, fun invite with Myra's name, the theme, Sun 13 Dec 5-8 pm, the venue, and an RSVP line to Divya by Wed 9 Dec.
assertions: Mentions Myra turning 7 and the unicorn theme
RSVP to Divya by Wed, 9 Dec

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally
